case_number: 2025 INSC 145; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.201 OF 2020; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.202 OF 2020

parties.respondent: State Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi

summary: Robbery prosecution under IPC s.392/397/411 and Arms Act s.25; FIR against unknown persons; identification and arrest without test parade; recovery of weapons but no looted articles; inconsistencies in PW testimony regarding arrest; improbable arrest timing and circumstances; prosecution case doubted due to lack of corroboration; benefit of doubt granted; conviction set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 136 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellants acquitted.
